Incident Bot: :rotating_light: Alert: Elevated 5xx + timeout rates detected for /v1/generate (hosted-api, us-west-2). Error rate bumped to 7.8% over 5m, latency p95 -> 3.2s. Paging @Eng Oncall. Links: dashboard/redwood/gateway-errors, logs/stream/1782745601

Maria G.: Oncall here, picking this up. Pulling up metrics, grabbing pager.

Raj P.: I can see scheduler backlog on the batching service. backlog_count=3124, oldest_request_age=42s, avg_batch_size=1.1 — looks like head-of-line (HOL) blocking in gpu-pool-5.

Sylvia K.: Likely cause: a few long-running calls with huge contexts are blocking continuous batching. We should: 1) enable bypass for critical routes, 2) route non-critical traffic to smaller quantized model, 3) temporarily increase scheduler worker count.

Maria G.: Agree. Quick plan: (A) put high-priority customer routes into bypass batching (low latency path), (B) apply model-fallback rule to reduce per-token time for burst traffic, (C) scale gpu-pool-5 by +6 nodes. Anyone object?

Tom L.: Scaling now. Running: `infra autoscale --pool gpu-pool-5 --delta 6 --reason "incident 1782745601"`

Raj P.: While we add nodes, I recommend toggling the batcher to `max_batch_latency=20ms` for the next 10m to reduce HOL. Also lower `max_batch_size` to 8 for /v1/generate to force more predictable batches.

Maria G.: Applying changes. 
Command: ```
redwood config set /routes/v1_generate/batching max_batch_latency=20ms max_batch_size=8 --uid incident-1782745601
redwood route override /v1/generate --model redwood-1-mini-q4 --duration 600s --reason "fallback to avoid HOL"
```

Deploy Bot: Configuration change applied by Maria G.: route override and batching params updated. 

Ops Run: Autoscale hit accepted, new GPU nodes provisioning (expected ready ~180s).

Raj P.: Observing ingress -> scheduler queue drain beginning. backlog_count -> 1400, error_rate down to 4.2% but still elevated. Seeing a tail of timeouts from the gateway at 504 for requests stuck >30s.

Eng Oncall: We're seeing a small subset of requests with very large token lengths (>=5000). Can we deny/short-circuit extremely large contexts temporarily?

Sylvia K.: Yes, add soft limit: reject or truncate contexts over 3000 tokens with a clear error message. That'll free the batcher quickly. Patch: `middleware: context-size-check` with `max_tokens=3000`.

Maria G.: Rolling a fast patch to the inference-gateway: `kubectl set env deploy/gateway CONTEXT_MAX_TOK=3000 --namespace hosted-api` and adding an explanatory 4xx response for clients. Applying now.

Deploy Bot: gateway deployment rollout started by Maria G. — rollout status: 1/3 pods ready.

CS Rep: Heads-up — two enterprise customers (acme-inc, dataworks) reported timeouts. CS has notified them we're mitigating; asked for temporary retry guidance and ETA ~10-15m.

Tom L.: New GPU nodes are ready and joined the pool. Pool size increased. monitoring/gpu-pool-5 shows utilization ~85% but backlog jumping down.

Raj P.: backlog_count -> 120, error_rate -> 1.1%, timeouts mostly resolved. p95 latency down to 900ms. HOL counters show fewer stuck requests.

CS Rep: Reporting back to customers: we applied fallback model, scaled pool, and added context-length protections. Customers accepted workaround; no major data loss, some elevated latencies earlier but requests resumed.

Maria G.: Marking page resolved for now. I'll keep the overrides in place for 20 minutes then gradually roll back. Creating an incident ticket: INC-1782745601. Severity: P2.

Sylvia K.: Action items for postmortem: 1) add prioritized request routing to avoid HOL (per-customer priority weights), 2) better context-size enforcement in clients/SDKs, 3) autoscaling policy review to avoid slow warm-up, 4) consider prewarming quantized fallback models.

Raj P.: Also recommend adding metric alert for `oldest_request_age > 30s` and `batcher_backlog_count > 500` with immediate paging. Current alert thresholds too loose.

Ops Run: Reverting batching overrides in 12m if stable. Leave route override for 20m as Maria said.

Maria G.: Confirming: last 5m error_rate avg = 0.9%, backlog=40. Closing page at 1782745690. I'll own the postmortem and include customer impact timeline and mitigation commands.`
